mapper.select: select count(*) from wish where MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} and PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.delete: delete from wish where member_id = #{memberId} and PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.select: select w.WISH_ID, w.MEMBER_ID, w.PRODUCT_ID, p.PRODUCT_TITLE as PRODUCT_NAME, (select pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH from PRODUCTIMAGE pi where pi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID and pi.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 and ROWNUM = 1) as IMAGE_PATH, (select pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME from PRODUCTIMAGE pi where pi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID and pi.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 and ROWNUM = 1) as TITLE_IMAGE, NVL((select MIN(po.OPTION_PRICE) from OPTIONDETAIL od join PRODUCTOPTION po on od.OPTION_ID = po.OPTION_ID where od.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID), 0) as PRICE, NVL((select ROUND(AVG(r.SCORE), 1) from REVIEW r join ORDERDETAIL rod on r.OD_ID = rod.OD_ID join OPTIONDETAIL rodt on rod.POP_ID = rodt.POP_ID where rodt.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID and r.REVIEW_STATUS = 1), 0) as SCORE, (select count(*) from REVIEW r join ORDERDETAIL rod on r.OD_ID = rod.OD_ID join OPTIONDETAIL rodt on rod.POP_ID = rodt.POP_ID where rodt.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID and r.REVIEW_STATUS = 1) as REVIEW_COUNT from WISH w join PRODUCT p on w.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID where w.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} order by w.WISH_ID desc
